title: Paint House
description: Calculate the minimum cost to paint a row of houses such that no two adjacent houses have the same color.
pseudocode:
1: for i from 1 to n-1:
2:   costs[i][0] += min(costs[i-1][1], costs[i-1][2])
3:   costs[i][1] += min(costs[i-1][0], costs[i-1][2])
4:   costs[i][2] += min(costs[i-1][0], costs[i-1][1])
5: return min(costs[n-1])

steps.note: Starting DP from the second house (index 1)
Updating red cost for house 1: 16 + min(2, 17) = 18
Updating blue cost for house 1: 16 + min(17, 17) = 33
Updating green cost for house 1: 5 + min(17, 2) = 7
Returning the minimum of the last row: min(18, 33, 7) = 7
